newsitem.title: UK: UK'S Signet says trade in current yr ahead.
newsitem.headline: UK'S Signet says trade in current yr ahead.

text.p: British jewellery retailer Signet Group Plc said on Wednesday that its sales on a like-for-like basis for the 14 weeks to May 10, 1997 were ahead of the year-ago period.
The company, which sells jewellery items in the UK and the U.S. said the sales were also in line with management's expectations.
However, Signet expressed caution saying the outcome for the whole year was dependent on trading in the final quarter and it was too early to identify any firm trend.
"Recovery of consumer confidence in the UK remains variable and in the U.S. historically high level of consumer debt and the recent rise in interest rates sound a note of caution.
